camera_lens.prompt: Dense editorial CAMERA & LENS reference board, 16:9, dark neutral look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, film-production house style, hand-set English labels, no photograph of a real person anywhere, no version number, no date, no board code, no client name, no photographer credit, no file name, no invented metadata of any kind. Headline: 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — CAMERA & LENS'. PANEL 1 CAMERA POSITION: a clean side-elevation diagram of a featureless wooden artist mannequin standing, the camera drawn at CHEST HEIGHT with its sight line dead horizontal and square to the mannequin, labelled 'CHEST HEIGHT · LEVEL · STRAIGHT ON'. Beside it a frame diagram with the horizon dead level, labelled 'ROLL LEVEL — NO TILT'. PANEL 2 PERSPECTIVE CHARACTER: two small comparison diagrams, one with converging verticals crossed out and one with strictly parallel verticals ticked, labelled 'VERTICALS PARALLEL · SLIGHTLY LONG · NO ENLARGEMENT OF NEAR LIMBS · THE WALL READS FLAT AND MILDLY COMPRESSED'. PANEL 3 DEPTH OF FIELD: a depth ramp showing the face and the garment texture sharp while the wall softens, with a note that the shadow edges stay readable, labelled 'SHALLOW TO MODERATE · FACE AND CLOTH TEXTURE SHARP · WALL SOFTENS BUT GOBO EDGES STAY READABLE'. PANEL 4 FOREGROUND OCCLUSION: an empty frame rectangle with a diagonal strike through it, labelled 'NONE — NOTHING CROSSES THE LENS'. PANEL 5 OPTICAL SIGNATURE, marked MANDATORY ON EVERY FRAME AND FIXED FOR THE WHOLE UNIT: sample tiles reading 'NO FLARE', 'GENTLE BLOOM IN THE BRIGHTEST WALL PATCHES ONLY', 'SLIGHT WARM HALATION WHERE THE LIT WALL MEETS THE DARK GARMENT', 'FINE LOW GRAIN', 'NO VIGNETTE', each tile carrying a strength word, and a line beneath reading 'THIS UNIT IS NEARLY CLEAN — ONE GENTLE BLOOM AND ONE WARM EDGE HALATION, NOTHING MORE; A GLOWING FRAME IS AS WRONG AS A FLAT ONE'. PANEL 6 FRAME: a portrait rectangle roughly 3 to 4 with a subject silhouette centred and cut at mid-thigh, generous empty space above the head where the shadow bar runs, labelled 'PORTRAIT · SUBJECT CENTRED · CUT MID-THIGH · SPACE ABOVE THE HEAD IS GIVEN TO THE GOBO'. Bottom edge: a palette row of five labelled swatches with the hex printed under each — #E4D3BE, #C9B49C, #6B4E3C, #1A1512, #D2A183. Clean technical board, very high type legibility, no people, no product, no brand mark, no readable text beyond the labels.

blocking.prompt: Rough pencil BLOCKING sketch on toned paper, 16:9, loose graphite gesture-rough with visible construction lines, NOT finished art, hand-lettered English labels, black and white pencil with one small colour swatch row, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline lettered 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — BLOCKING'. MAIN FRAME: a featureless wooden artist mannequin — no face, no facial features at all, no hair, no gender, no clothing detail — standing THREE-QUARTERS to the lens with one shoulder nearer the camera. Draw the limb chain explicitly as joints and directions, not as a named pose: on the near side the upper arm hangs down and slightly back from the shoulder, the elbow bends sharply and points away from the body sideways, the forearm angles forward and inward, and the wrist rests on the crest of the hip with the palm facing back onto the hip; on the far side the whole arm hangs plumb from the shoulder, elbow almost straight, wrist beside the thigh, palm facing inward toward the leg. Letter 'NEAR ARM: HAND ON HIP CREST, ELBOW OUT SIDEWAYS · FAR ARM: HANGS PLUMB'. Draw the weight shifted onto the leg on the hip-hand side, that hip riding higher, the far leg relaxed and slightly out, lettered 'WEIGHT ON THE HIP-HAND SIDE — THAT HIP RIDES HIGH'. For the head give pan, tilt and roll separately: letter 'HEAD PAN SLIGHT TOWARD THE LENS SIDE · SMALL TILT · ROLL NEUTRAL · CHIN LEVEL', and draw the eye-line arrow running straight and level into the lens. Draw the camera at chest height with an arrow for its level sight line. Draw the hard low source entering from camera-RIGHT with rays raking almost along the wall, and draw the CAST GOBO on the wall behind as a large soft-edged upright bar crossed by a horizontal bar, reading as a window frame, lettered 'HARD LOW SOURCE FROM CAMERA-RIGHT, RAKING ALONG THE WALL · LARGE SOFT-EDGED WINDOW GOBO IS THE COMPOSITION'. Letter 'ROLL LEVEL' and 'CUT AT MID-THIGH'. BOXED TOP-DOWN PLAN INSET in the bottom-right corner, drawn inside a ruled box: bird's-eye view showing the mannequin footprint with a facing arrow angled three-quarters toward the camera, the two feet marked with the weighted one shaded, the camera marker with its angle wedge, the wall drawn as a straight line close behind the figure, and the light direction arrow entering from the camera-right side at a grazing angle to that wall, lettered 'TOP-DOWN PLAN'. Small palette row bottom-left with hex lettered: #E4D3BE, #6B4E3C, #1A1512. Schematic diagram only, no rendering, no faces, no features on the mannequin, no text other than the hand-lettered labels.

expression_gaze.prompt: Dense editorial EXPRESSION & GAZE reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — EXPRESSION & GAZE'. Show FOUR VERY LARGE head studies of the SAME neutral unnamed generic face, identical identity in every panel, each head filling the height of its panel so that EYELID HEIGHT IS PLAINLY MEASURABLE — the eyes must be rendered large and in fine detail, because lid height is the load-bearing detail of this sheet. Every panel shows the head come fully round to the lens with a level chin. Panel labels, lettered exactly: 'GAZE STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS, LEVEL — THE MOST DIRECT FORMAT'; 'UPPER LIDS SLIGHTLY LOWERED, THE EDITORIAL HALF-LID — TOP OF THE IRIS JUST COVERED, SYMMETRIC, NO WHITE ABOVE OR BELOW, LOWER LID RELAXED'; 'BROWS AT REST AND LEVEL — NO ARCH LIFT, NO INNER-BROW PULL'; 'CHEEKBONES AT REST — THE MIDFACE STAYS FLAT, NO CHEEK LIFT, NO CREASE UNDER THE LOWER LID; A DIRECT GAZE WITH AN UNENGAGED MIDFACE READS AS SELF-POSSESSION, NOT WARMTH'. Add a panel headed 'MOUTH': 'CLOSED, LIPS FULL, CORNERS LEVEL TO A FRACTION BELOW LEVEL · SOFT, NO TENSION'. Add a panel headed 'JAW AND NECK': 'JAW RELAXED, NO MASSETER · CHIN LEVEL · NECK LONG AND UNSHORTENED'. Add a small diagram panel headed 'HEAD ORIENTATION' with three icons for pan, tilt and roll carrying the values 'PAN SLIGHT TOWARD THE LENS SIDE · SMALL TILT · ROLL NEUTRAL — BODY THREE-QUARTERS WHILE THE HEAD COMES FULLY ROUND'. Add a NEGATIVES strip lettered 'NOT LIFTED · NOT ARCHED · NO CHEEK LIFT · NO CREASE UNDER THE LOWER LID · CORNERS NEVER TURNED UP · NO SMILE OF ANY KIND'. Add a signature strip lettered 'SIGNATURE: ZERO PERFORMANCE. NOTHING OFFERED TO THE CAMERA AND NOTHING WITHHELD — THE STILLEST FACE OF THE FIVE'. Bottom palette row with hex printed: #D2A183, #E4D3BE, #1A1512. Light the studies with a hard low rake from camera-right and strong warm bounce filling the shadow side, so the moderate facial contrast reads truthfully. Very high label legibility, fine skin detail, no named individual, no brand text.

garment_behaviour.prompt: Dense editorial GARMENT BEHAVIOUR reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — GARMENT BEHAVIOUR'. This sheet studies WHAT CLOTH DOES, never what cloth is: plain unbranded UNPRINTED fabric studies only, no pattern, no logo, no garment silhouette, no product, no colourway claim. PANEL 1 MOTION STATE: a fabric study hanging fully settled and inert, labelled 'STILL · FULLY SETTLED · NO AIR IN IT'. PANEL 2 AIR INTERACTION: cloth hanging straight and gathering only where a body would put it, labelled 'NONE — THE CLOTH HANGS AND GATHERS WHERE THE BODY PUTS IT'. PANEL 3 DRAPE AND WEIGHT: a fold study showing dense small-scale gathering that stays exactly where it is set, fold radius very tight and packed, labelled 'LIGHT · DENSE SMALL-SCALE GATHERING THAT STAYS SET · FOLD RADIUS VERY TIGHT AND PACKED'. PANEL 4 TRANSPARENCY UNDER THIS LIGHT: the same plain cloth shown over a skin-toned surface under a hard low rake, reading as a dark veil where a single layer sits so the surface beneath shows through, and fully opaque where the gathers stack layers, labelled 'SHEER UNDER THE RAKE · SINGLE LAYER READS AS A DARK VEIL OVER SKIN · STACKED LAYERS READ OPAQUE · THIS IS A PROPERTY OF THE LIGHT-AND-CLOTH PAIR, NOT OF THE CLOTH ALONE'. PANEL 5 EDGE QUALITY: a hem at rest, labelled 'SOFT · UNSTRESSED · NO MOTION, NO FLUTTER, NO BLUR'. PANEL 6 SURFACE RESPONSE: labelled 'MATTE — THE RAKE PICKS OUT THE TEXTURE OF THE GATHERING RATHER THAN MAKING A HIGHLIGHT'. TRANSFER STRIP along the bottom, lettered: 'THE APPROVED ITEM HANGS AT REST HERE AND THE RAKING LIGHT DESCRIBES ITS SURFACE — A HEAVY GARMENT SHOWS ITS WEAVE AND ITS SEAMS UNDER THE RAKE, A LIGHT ONE LETS THE RAKE THROUGH WHERE IT IS SINGLE-LAYERED. NOTHING MOVES'. Palette row with hex printed: #1A1512, #E4D3BE, #D2A183. Light every panel with the same hard low rake from camera-right so the transparency panel reads truthfully. Very high label legibility, no people, no faces.

colour_grade.prompt: Dense editorial COLOUR & GRADE reference board, 16:9, dark look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no board code, no client name, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — COLOUR & GRADE'. PANEL PALETTE, marked 'CLOSED SET · PALETTE_SIZE 5': five large swatches in a row, each with its name above and its hex printed beneath in clear monospace type — 'WARM CREAM #E4D3BE', 'GREIGE MID #C9B49C', 'DEEP WARM SHADOW #6B4E3C', 'BLACK GARMENT #1A1512', 'WARM SKIN #D2A183'. Letter beneath the row: 'FIVE VALUES ONLY, ONE WARM NEUTRAL FAMILY — THIS IS WHY THE FRAME READS AS ITSELF'. PANEL EXEMPTIONS, three lines: 'THE APPROVED ITEM OWN COLOURS', 'SKIN HAIR EYES', 'THE NEUTRAL RAMP BETWEEN TWO DECLARED MEMBERS'. PANEL FORBIDDEN: 'ANY SIXTH COLOUR IS A FAIL, NOT A VARIATION — A GREEN PLANT, A BLUE SKY OR A SATURATED PROP BREAKS THIS UNIT'. PANEL CURVE: a tone-curve graph drawn as a gentle S with the black end lifted rather than crushed, annotated 'GENTLE S CURVE · NO CRUSHED BLACKS · SHADOWS WARM AND OPEN · HIGHLIGHTS SOFT AND ROLLED, NOT CLIPPED'. PANEL SPLIT-TONE: annotated 'NO SPLIT — WARM NEUTRAL THROUGHOUT · THE WALL BOUNCE CARRIES THE SAME WARMTH INTO THE SHADOW SIDE, SO LIT AND SHADOWED VALUES SIT IN ONE FAMILY'. PANEL FAIL CONDITION, written so a gate can run it: 'QUANTISE THE DELIVERED FRAME, DROP SKIN HAIR AND EYES AND THE DECLARED ITEM COLOURS, AND EVERY REMAINING CLUSTER OVER 2 PERCENT OF FRAME AREA MUST MAP TO A PALETTE MEMBER WITHIN A DISTANCE OF 20'. PANEL GRADED SAMPLE: one clean graded plate of a warm cream-greige wall carrying a large soft-edged rectangular window shadow, with NO person in it, carrying the palette exactly. Clean technical board, very high type legibility, no people, no product, no photograph of a face, no brand mark.

environment.prompt: Dense editorial ENVIRONMENT PLATES board, 21:9, labelled panels, architectural reference style, hand-set English labels, THE SAME PLACE throughout with identical materials and identical light across every panel, NO PEOPLE in any panel, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — ENVIRONMENT'. PLATE 1 PLAN: a top-down site diagram showing one flat wall, the subject footprint in front of it, the camera at chest height square to the wall, and the hard low light arrow entering from the camera-right side at a grazing angle to the wall, with the off-frame window that shapes the gobo marked on the plan, plus a scale bar and a north arrow. PLATE 2 HERO WIDE: the warm cream-greige wall carrying a large soft-edged rectangular shadow — an upright bar crossed by a horizontal bar, reading as a window frame — raked by a hard low source, nothing else in frame, no props, no floor, no furniture. PLATE 3 REVERSE ANGLE: the SAME wall seen from AT LEAST 120 DEGREES around the room, a genuinely and obviously different viewpoint and NOT a repeat of the hero — from here the wall is seen along its length in steep foreshortening rather than face-on, the gobo bars now run across the surface at a visibly different angle and skew, and the source is now nearly behind the camera rather than off to one side. The two plates must not be mistakable for one another. PLATE 4 MATERIALS: five labelled swatches — rendered warm cream wall plaster in #E4D3BE, the same plaster outside the bright field in #C9B49C, the plaster in gobo shadow in #6B4E3C, dark gathered sheer textile in #1A1512, warm skin reference in #D2A183. PLATE 5 SIGNATURE DETAILS: the soft-edged shadow boundary itself at close range showing its gradient rather than a crisp line, the plaster grain picked out by the rake, and the transition where the shadow bar crosses a small surface imperfection. PLATE 6 ATMOSPHERE: labelled tiles for LIGHT 'one hard low source through a window, raking almost along the wall from camera-right', HAZE 'none, the air is clear', TEMPERATURE 'warm, late-day', plus short SOUND and SMELL notes. Annotate the depth planes as two labelled bands only: 'WALL · SUBJECT', and letter 'THERE IS NO THIRD PLANE — THAT FLATNESS AND THE SHADOW ARE THE WHOLE ENVIRONMENT'. Letter one line: 'UNKNOWN — ROOM SIZE, WHAT IS BEHIND THE CAMERA, AND THE TRUE WINDOW GEOMETRY; ONLY THE SHADOW IT THROWS IS READABLE'. High detail, very high label legibility, no people, no readable brand text.

person.prompt: Dense editorial PERSON SHEET, 2:3, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no board code, no credit, no invented metadata. Headline 'WINDOW GOBO WARM — PERSON SHEET (TEMPLATE)'. This sheet is a TEMPLATE describing what must be recorded about whoever is photographed, never a portrait of a specific individual: use one neutral unnamed generic face, identical in every panel, and label the anatomy rather than naming a person. PANEL FACE GEOMETRY: an annotated diagram calling out skull and jaw shape, cheekbone height and projection, brow ridge, nose bridge and tip and nostril shape, philtrum, lip volume and corner direction, chin, hairline shape, and the neck-to-jaw transition. PANEL EARS: a labelled ear study calling out set height relative to the eye and nose line, protrusion, helix curl, lobe attached or free, and piercings, lettered 'EARS ARE THE FASTEST TELL OF DRIFT'. PANEL EVERYTHING ON THE FACE: brow density and direction and gaps, lashes, eye colour and limbal ring, iris pattern, sclera tone, under-eye structure, and glasses frame if worn. PANEL SKIN MARKS, two clearly separated columns lettered 'OBSERVED — READ OFF A FRAME' and 'PLAUSIBLE — CONSISTENT WITH THE OBSERVED TYPE BUT NOT VISIBLE', with a line beneath: 'DISCRETE MARKS MUST BE OBSERVED · CONTINUOUS GEOMETRY MAY BE INFERRED ACROSS ANGLES · NEVER BLUR THE TWO'. PANEL SKIN TONE: a value ramp with hex printed including #D2A183, plus undertone and the lit-to-shadow shift, lettered 'THE WARM WALL BOUNCE FILLS THE SHADOW SIDE, SO BOTH SIDES STAY IN ONE WARM FAMILY'. PANEL HOW THIS SKIN TAKES THIS LIGHT: annotated close studies lettered 'MEDIUM-TIGHT SPECULARS ON CHEEKBONE, NOSE BRIDGE AND COLLARBONE'; 'SHADOW TERMINATOR CRISP BUT NOT HARD'; 'STRONG WARM WALL BOUNCE FILLS THE SHADOW SIDE, SO FACIAL CONTRAST IS MODERATE DESPITE A HARD SOURCE'; 'FINE FACIAL HAIR AND STRAY STRANDS CATCH THE RAKE AND GLOW'; 'SLIGHT WARM HALATION WHERE A LIT SKIN EDGE MEETS THE DARK GARMENT'. Light every study with the same hard low rake from camera-right plus strong warm bounce, so the terminator and the moderate contrast read truthfully. Palette row with hex printed: #D2A183, #E4D3BE, #6B4E3C. Very high label legibility, fine skin detail, no named individual, no brand text.
